query:
UPDATE molecules SET 
  radar_intensity = 70,
  radar_freshness = 25,
  radar_warmth = 75,
  radar_sweetness = 95,
  radar_spiciness = 15,
  radar_earthiness = 30
WHERE (olfactiveProfile LIKE '%vanille%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%vanilla%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%gourmand%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%caramel%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%chocolat%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%sweet%')
  AND radar_intensity = 50 AND radar_freshness = 50
